rule.list_shape: 4..=32 unique ASCII identifiers; one list must be an ordered subsequence of the other, equality accepted
rule.selection_casefold: ASCII case-insensitive labels and ordered list items
rule.head_metric: case-insensitive word-set Jaccard; label participates in Jaccard but is excluded from the shared-before-label gate
rule.reciprocal_margin: unique best on both sides and each best score is at least twice the actual runner-up
rule.eligibility_order: eligibility is checked only after the complete all-candidate census

tests.detail: four real source candidates produce one trueCore->Core selection

tests.name: reordered_lists_reject
tests.detail: an order inversion is not an ordered subsequence

tests.detail: an exact source candidate duplicate creates a reciprocal top tie

tests.name: equal_head_competitor_vetoes
tests.detail: case-insensitively equal heads tie the reciprocal best rank

tests.detail: eligibility is applied after the complete census, so no Profile/Gloss rematch occurs

limitations: This is an experimental selector and does not establish an acceptance policy.
Section context evidence is neutral; no heading evidence is inferred.
Source ownership, exact output diff construction, and production integration are out of scope.
The fixture census is bounded to the six captured valid candidates and does not claim whole-corpus behavior.
